# Setup

```{r message=FALSE, results='hide', warning=FALSE}
library(pacman)
pacman::p_load(
  tidyverse,
  ggplot2, 
  rio, 
  here,
  table1,
  flextable,
  Surrogate, 
  tictoc
)

source(here("Code", "Helper_functions.R"))
source(here("Code", "ICA.BinCont.Cov_inner.R"))


options(scipen = 999)
```

# Load datasets

```{r}
analysis_h1n1 <- import(here("Raw_data", "analysis_h1n1.sas7bdat"))
analysis_h3n2 <- import(here("Raw_data", "analysis_h3n2.sas7bdat"))

# Convert character empty cells -> NA
analysis_h1n1 <- analysis_h1n1 |> clean_missing()
analysis_h3n2 <- analysis_h3n2 |> clean_missing()

# Recode the treatment indicator
analysis_h1n1 <- analysis_h1n1 %>%
  mutate(
    ARM = factor(ARM, levels = c(1, 2), labels = c("NIV", "QIV"))
         ) %>%
  arrange(log_hi)
analysis_h3n2 <- analysis_h3n2 %>%
  mutate(
    ARM = factor(ARM, levels = c(1, 2), labels = c("NIV", "QIV"))         
    ) %>%
  arrange(log_hi)

```

# Select starting values for model parameters

## Mean HI of two groups

### Post-vacc HI titer comparison across arms, between those who had and did not have infection

A/H1N1 HI:

```{r warning=FALSE}
#| label: fig-prepost_HI_h1
#| fig-cap: "Distribution of post-vaccination A/H1N1 HI titer by treatment arms"


ggplot(analysis_h1n1, aes(x=log_hi, colour = ARM, fill = ARM)) +
  geom_histogram(bins = 30) +
  facet_grid(cols = vars(ARM)) +
  labs(y = "Number of subjects", 
       x = "Log(e) A/H1N1 HI titer") + 
  scale_fill_manual(values = c("#2f357c", "#bf3729")) +
  scale_color_manual(values = c("#2f357c", "#bf3729")) + 
  scale_x_continuous(breaks = seq(1, 10, by =0.5)) +
  theme_minimal() + 
    theme(legend.position = "none")
```

```{r}
table1(~ log_hi | ARM + h1n1, data = analysis_h1n1,
       render.continuous = c(.= "Mean (SD)", 
                             .="Median [Q1, Q3]",
                             .= "Min - Max"))
table1(~ log_hi | h1n1 + ARM, data = analysis_h1n1)
```

A/H3N2 HI:

```{r warning=FALSE}
#| label: fig-prepost_HI_h3
#| fig-cap: "Distribution of post-vaccination A/H3N2 HI titer by treatment arms"


ggplot(analysis_h3n2, aes(x=log_hi, colour = ARM, fill = ARM)) +
  geom_histogram(bins = 20) +
  facet_grid(cols = vars(ARM)) +
  labs(y = "Number of subjects", 
       x = "Log(e) A/H3N2 HI titer") + 
  scale_fill_manual(values = c("#2f357c", "#bf3729")) +
  scale_color_manual(values = c("#2f357c", "#bf3729")) + 
  scale_x_continuous(breaks = seq(1, 10, by =0.5)) +
  theme_minimal() + 
    theme(legend.position = "none")
```

```{r}
table1(~ log_hi | ARM + h3n2, data = analysis_h3n2)

quantile(
  analysis_h3n2$log_hi[
    analysis_h3n2$ARM == "NIV" & analysis_h3n2$h3n2 == 1
  ]
)

quantile(
  analysis_h3n2$log_hi[
    analysis_h3n2$ARM == "NIV" & analysis_h3n2$h3n2 == 0
  ]
)

quantile(
  analysis_h3n2$log_hi[
    analysis_h3n2$ARM == "QIV" & analysis_h3n2$h3n2 == 1
  ]
)

quantile(
  analysis_h3n2$log_hi[
    analysis_h3n2$ARM == "QIV" & analysis_h3n2$h3n2 == 0
  ]
)
```

### Select values based on observed data

Based on the above figures and tables, the following values are chosen:

**HI H1N1**

```{r}
# Create dataset
h1_params <- data.frame(
  parameter = c(
    "mu0_00", "mu0_01", "mu0_10", "mu0_11",
    "mu1_00", "mu1_01", "mu1_10", "mu1_11"
  ),
  group = c(
    "Control", "Control", "Control", "Control",
    "QIV", "QIV", "QIV", "QIV"
  ),
  stratum = c(
    "00", "01", "10", "11",
    "00", "01", "10", "11"
  ),
  explanation = c(
    "Mean HI in control, infected under both",
    "Mean HI in control, infected under control only",
    "Mean HI in control, infected under vaccination only",
    "Mean HI in control, protected under both",
    "Mean HI in QIV, infected under both",
    "Mean HI in QIV, infected under control only",
    "Mean HI in QIV, infected under vaccination only",
    "Mean HI in QIV, protected under both"
  ),
  value = c(1.6, 2.5, 3.0, 4.5, 3.0, 4.0, 4.5, 5.5)
)

# View dataset


h1_params2 <- flextable::flextable(h1_params) |>
  set_caption("Parameters for log HI H1N1") |>
  bold(part = "header") |>
  fontsize(size = 11) |>
  align(align = "center", part = "header") |>
  autofit()

h1_params2

mu0_h1_params <- h1_params$value[h1_params$group=="Control"]
mu1_h1_params <- h1_params$value[h1_params$group=="QIV"]
mu0_h1_params_old <- c(1.9, 3.0, 4.0, 5.0)
```

**HI H3N2**

| Parameter | Explanation | Value |
|-------------------|----------------------------------|-------------------|
| $\mu_0^{00}$ | Mean HI in control group, of those who would be infected under both control and vaccination | 1.6 |
| $\mu_0^{01}$ | Mean HI in control group, of those who would be infected under control but proteced under vaccination | 2.0 |
| $\mu_0^{10}$ | Mean HI in control group, of those who would be protected under control but infected under vaccination | 4.0 |
| $\mu_0^{11}$ | Mean HI in control group, of those who would be protected under both control and vaccination | 5.0 |
| $\mu_1^{00}$ | Mean HI in QIV group, of those who would be infected under both control and vaccination | 3.5 |
| $\mu_1^{01}$ | Mean HI in QIV group, of those who would be infected under control but proteced under vaccination | 4.0 |
| $\mu_1^{10}$ | Mean HI in QIV group, of those who would be protected under control but infected under vaccination | 4.5 |
| $\mu_1^{11}$ | Mean HI in QIV group, of those who would be protected under both control and vaccination | 5.0 |

: Parameters for log HI H3N2

## Standard deviation HI of two groups

Based on the above tables, three SV for the variance $\sigma_{00} = \sigma_{11} = \{0.64, 1, 2.25,4\}$ will be examined. The corresponding standard deviations are {0.8, 1, 1.5, 2}.

# ITCI CoP analysis

## H1N1

### Marginal prob of true endpoint

```{r}
pi_1. <- mean(analysis_h1n1$no_h1n1[analysis_h1n1$ARM == "NIV"])
pi_0. <- 1 - pi_1.
pi_.1  <- mean(analysis_h1n1$no_h1n1[analysis_h1n1$ARM == "QIV"])
pi_.0 = 1 - pi_.1

up_g_pi_10 <- min(pi_.0, pi_1.)
```

### Without bootstrapping

#### SD = 0.8

```{r}
# mu0 = 1.6, 2.5, 3.0, 4.5
tic("ICA analysis")
ica_h1_sd08_no_boot <- ICA.BinCont(
  Dataset = analysis_h1n1,
  Surr = log_hi,
  True = no_h1n1,             
  Treat = treat, 
  BS = FALSE,    #No bootstrap
  G_pi_10 = c(0, up_g_pi_10),
  Theta.S_0 = c(mu0_h1_params, rep(0.8, times = 4)),
  Theta.S_1 = c(mu1_h1_params, rep(0.8, times = 4)),
  M = 1000,
  Seed = 2026,
  Save.Plots = here("Plot"),
  Show.Details = TRUE
)
toc() # 10 mins
```

```{r}
ica_h1_sd08_no_boot_df <- fit_to_df(ica_h1_sd08_no_boot, boot_id = 1)
ica_h1_sd08_no_boot_df <- ica_h1_sd08_no_boot_df %>%
  mutate(AIC_S0 = dev_S0 + 2*5,
         AIC_S1 = dev_S1 + 1*5)
export(ica_h1_sd08_no_boot_df, here("Results", "ica_h1_sd08_no_boot_df.csv"))
ica_h1_sd08_no_boot_summary <- summarise_ICA(ica_h1_sd08_no_boot_df,
                                             output_dir = here("Plot", "Screening for SV"))
```

```{r}
summary(ica_h1_sd08_no_boot)

plot(ica_h1_sd08_no_boot)

cat("\n")

summary(ica_h1_sd08_no_boot$dev_S0)
summary(ica_h1_sd08_no_boot$dev_S1)
sd(ica_h1_sd08_no_boot$dev_S0)
sd(ica_h1_sd08_no_boot$dev_S1)

cat("\n Mean \n ")
summary(ica_h1_sd08_no_boot$mean_Y_S0)
ica_h1_sd08_no_boot$mean.S0
summary(ica_h1_sd08_no_boot$mean_Y_S1)
ica_h1_sd08_no_boot$mean.S1

cat("\n Variance \n ")
summary(ica_h1_sd08_no_boot$var_Y_S0)
ica_h1_sd08_no_boot$var.S0
summary(ica_h1_sd08_no_boot$var_Y_S1)
ica_h1_sd08_no_boot$var.S1
```

### Model with covariate

#### Starting values based on linear model

```{r}
analysis_h1n1_QIV <- analysis_h1n1 %>% filter(treat == 1)
analysis_h1n1_control <- analysis_h1n1 %>% filter(treat == -1)


hi_h1n1_QIV_pred2 <- lm(log_hi ~ center_log_hi_base, data = analysis_h1n1_QIV)
summary(hi_h1n1_QIV_pred2)


cat("Initial SD QIV:" , sd(residuals(hi_h1n1_QIV_pred2)))
```

```{r}
ica_identify <- ICA.BinCont.Cov(
  Dataset = analysis_h1n1,
  Surr = log_hi,
  True = no_h1n1,             
  Treat = treat,
  Cov = center_log_hi_base,
  G_pi_10 = c(0, up_g_pi_10),
  Theta.S_0 = c(b1_SV_S0, b2_SV_S0, b3_SV_S0, b4_SV_S0, beta_sv_S0, sigma_S0),
  Theta.S_1 = c(b1_SV_S1, b2_SV_S1, b3_SV_S1, b4_SV_S1, beta_sv_S1, sigma_S1),
  M = 100,
  Seed = 2026,
  Center.Cov=FALSE,
  Monotonicity=TRUE,
  Independence=FALSE,
  HAA=TRUE,
  Cond_ind=TRUE,  
  Show.Details = TRUE
)
```
